description: The Level 1 recommendations from the CIS Google Android benchmark that map to Android Management API policy fields. Many recommendations cover Google account settings or on-device UI that an EMM cannot control, so they remain listed as unmapped. This is not a reproduction of the benchmark text.

controls.title: Firmware current
controls.description: Keep the device firmware on the current supported release.

controls.title: Screen lock
controls.description: Require a screen lock with a complex password policy.

controls.title: Pattern visibility
controls.description: Do not show the unlock pattern on screen.
controls.note: The Android Management API does not expose pattern visibility.

controls.title: Automatic lock
controls.description: Lock the device as soon as the screen turns off.
controls.note: The API's maximum-time-to-lock value cannot represent 'immediate' separately from the screen timeout control below.

controls.title: Power button lock
controls.description: Lock the device when the power button is pressed.
controls.note: The Android Management API does not expose this behaviour.

controls.title: Lock screen message
controls.description: Show a managed message on the lock screen.

value.defaultMessage: This device is managed by your organization.

settings.displayValue: {"defaultMessage":"This device is managed by your organization."}

controls.title: Developer options
controls.description: Disable developer options and USB debugging.

controls.title: Unknown app installs
controls.description: Block installation from unknown sources.

controls.title: Rooted devices
controls.description: Prevent use of a rooted device.
controls.note: The API can report device integrity but has no policy switch that prohibits rooting.

controls.title: Network time
controls.description: Use network-provided time and time zone.

controls.title: Remote location
controls.description: Allow the organisation to locate the device remotely.
controls.note: This is an account-level Find My Device capability, not a policy value.

controls.title: Remote lock and erase
controls.description: Allow the organisation to lock and erase the device remotely.
controls.note: Remote lock and erase are commands, not policy settings.

controls.title: Threat scanning
controls.description: Scan installed apps for security threats.

controls.title: Harmful app detection
controls.description: Keep Google Play Protect harmful-app detection enabled.
controls.note: Play Protect verification covers both threat scanning and harmful-app detection.

controls.title: Unpinning authentication
controls.description: Require unlock before leaving a pinned app.
controls.note: The API does not expose screen pinning.

controls.title: Screen timeout
controls.description: Lock the screen after at most two minutes.

controls.title: Wi-Fi assistant
controls.description: Disable Wi-Fi assistant.
controls.note: The API does not expose Wi-Fi assistant.

controls.title: App updates
controls.description: Keep managed apps up to date automatically.

controls.title: Add users from lock screen
controls.description: Stop adding users from the lock screen.
controls.note: The API blocks adding users entirely, which also covers the lock screen path.

controls.title: Guest profiles
controls.description: Ensure no guest profiles exist.
controls.note: The API blocks new users, which prevents new guest profiles.

controls.title: App permissions review
controls.description: Review app permissions periodically.
controls.note: This is a process recommendation; the API can set default permission grants but cannot schedule a review.

controls.title: Bluetooth pairing
controls.description: Configure Bluetooth pairing.
controls.note: The API can disable Bluetooth but does not expose pairing controls.

controls.title: Third-party keyboards
controls.description: Disallow third-party keyboards.
controls.note: The API can allow-list input methods, but the template cannot choose a keyboard package for every fleet.

controls.title: User profile review
controls.description: Review existing user profiles periodically.
controls.note: This is a process recommendation with no policy value.

controls.title: Lock screen notifications
controls.description: Hide notifications on the lock screen.

controls.title: Web and app activity
controls.description: Disable Google web and app activity.
controls.note: This is a Google account setting, not a device policy.

controls.title: Device information sharing
controls.description: Disable Google device information sharing.
controls.note: This is a Google account setting, not a device policy.

controls.title: Voice and audio activity
controls.description: Disable Google voice and audio activity.
controls.note: This is a Google account setting, not a device policy.

controls.title: YouTube search history
controls.description: Disable YouTube search history.
controls.note: This is a Google account setting, not a device policy.

controls.title: YouTube watch history
controls.description: Disable YouTube watch history.
controls.note: This is a Google account setting, not a device policy.

controls.title: Location history
controls.description: Disable Google Location History.
controls.note: Location History is an account setting; device location is controlled separately.

controls.title: Ads personalisation
controls.description: Opt out of ads personalisation.
controls.note: The Android Management API does not expose this Google account setting.

controls.title: Wi-Fi scanning
controls.description: Disable Wi-Fi scanning.
controls.note: The API does not expose background Wi-Fi scanning.

controls.title: Bluetooth scanning
controls.description: Disable Bluetooth scanning.
controls.note: The API does not expose background Bluetooth scanning.

controls.title: Microphone
controls.description: Keep microphone access enabled for managed apps.

controls.title: Location
controls.description: Keep device location enabled.

controls.title: Third-party cookies
controls.description: Disable third-party cookies.
controls.note: The Android Management API does not expose browser cookie policy.

controls.title: Safe Browsing
controls.description: Keep Safe Browsing enabled.
controls.note: Safe Browsing is a browser setting; Play Protect verification is mapped separately under 1.17.
